Based on my thorough analysis, I have identified all the concrete types that implement the `IndexCache` interface in the `grafana/mimir` repository. 

## Answer

The following **3 files** would fail to compile because their concrete types implement the `IndexCache` interface but do not have the new `DeleteBlock` method:

1. **`pkg/storegateway/indexcache/inmemory.go`** - Contains the `InMemoryIndexCache` type
2. **`pkg/storegateway/indexcache/memcached.go`** - Contains the `MemcachedIndexCache` type  
3. **`pkg/storegateway/indexcache/tracing.go`** - Contains the `tracingIndexCache` type

Each of these types currently implements all the existing methods of the `IndexCache` interface (such as `StorePostings`, `FetchMultiPostings`, `StoreSeriesForRef`, `FetchMultiSeriesForRefs`, `StoreExpandedPostings`, `FetchExpandedPostings`, `StoreSeriesForPostings`, `FetchSeriesForPostings`, `StoreLabelNames`, `FetchLabelNames`, `StoreLabelValues`, `FetchLabelValues`), but none of them implement the new `DeleteBlock(ctx context.Context, userID string, blockID ulid.ULID) error` method.

When the `DeleteBlock` method is added to the `IndexCache` interface, Go's compile-time interface satisfaction check will fail for all three concrete types, causing compilation errors until the method is implemented in each file.

79 | // LabelMatchersKey represents a canonical key for a []*matchers.Matchers slice
80 | type LabelMatchersKey string
81 | 
82 | // CanonicalLabelMatchersKey creates a canonical version of LabelMatchersKey
83 | func CanonicalLabelMatchersKey(ms []*labels.Matcher) LabelMatchersKey {
84 | 	sorted := make([]labels.Matcher, len(ms))
85 | 	for i := range ms {
86 | 		sorted[i] = labels.Matcher{Type: ms[i].Type, Name: ms[i].Name, Value: ms[i].Value}
87 | 	}
88 | 	sort.Sort(sortedLabelMatchers(sorted))
89 | 
90 | 	const (
91 | 		typeLen = 2
92 | 		sepLen  = 1
93 | 	)
94 | 	var size int
95 | 	for _, m := range sorted {
96 | 		size += len(m.Name) + len(m.Value) + typeLen + sepLen
97 | 	}
98 | 	sb := strings.Builder{}
99 | 	sb.Grow(size)
100 | 	for _, m := range sorted {
101 | 		sb.WriteString(m.Name)
102 | 		sb.WriteString(m.Type.String())
103 | 		sb.WriteString(m.Value)
104 | 		sb.WriteByte(0)
105 | 	}
106 | 	return LabelMatchersKey(sb.String())
107 | }

109 | type sortedLabelMatchers []labels.Matcher
110 | 
111 | func (c sortedLabelMatchers) Less(i, j int) bool {
112 | 	if c[i].Name != c[j].Name {
113 | 		return c[i].Name < c[j].Name
114 | 	}
115 | 	if c[i].Type != c[j].Type {
116 | 		return c[i].Type < c[j].Type
117 | 	}
118 | 	return c[i].Value < c[j].Value
119 | }

122 | func (c sortedLabelMatchers) Swap(i, j int) { c[i], c[j] = c[j], c[i] }
